name: Gabii M + Mota 4475 + LMS - Psy Frequency apresenta noite de hardtechno
description: Psy Frequency hosts a hardtechno night featuring sets from Gabii M, Mota 4475, and LMS at Era uma vez no Porto.
longDescription:
Psy Frequency presents a hardtechno club night at Era uma vez no Porto, located at Rua da Madeira, 126. The lineup features Gabii M, Mota 4475, and LMS.

The party takes place on 12 November 2026, starting at 23:59. Entry is restricted to attendees aged 18 and over.
